claim.claim-text: 1. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use in a method for treatment of Fabry disease in a human patient in need thereof, the method comprising administering to the patient a therapeutically effective dose of the migalastat or salt thereof, wherein the patient has an α-galactosidase A mutation selected from the group consisting of: V22G, N34H, G80V, Q107R, Y152D, A156S, L189F, W204L, S238G, I239M, A257V, P259Q, N320H, P323T, E338V, P380L and T412P.
2. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to claim 1, wherein the patient has an α-galactosidase A mutation selected from the group consisting of: V22G, Q107R, L189F, W204L and P380L.
3. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to claim 1, wherein the patient has an α-galactosidase A mutation selected from the group consisting of: W204L, S238G, I239M, A257V, P259Q and N320H.
4. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to claim 1, wherein the patient has the α-galactosidase A mutation T412P.
5. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the migalastat or salt thereof is administered to the patient every other day.

6. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the patient is administered about 100 to about 150 mg free base equivalent of the migalastat or salt thereof every other day.

7. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the patient is administered about 123 mg free base equivalent of the migalastat or salt thereof every other day, or wherein the patient is administered about 123 mg of migalastat free base every other day, or wherein the patient is administered about 150 mg of migalastat hydrochloride every other day.

8. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the migalastat or salt thereof is administered orally, or wherein the migalastat or salt thereof is administered by injection.
9. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the migalastat or salt thereof enhances α-galactosidase A activity.
10. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the migalastat or salt thereof reduces globotriaosylceramide (GL-3) accumulation.
11. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein the migalastat or salt thereof reduces plasma globotriaosylsphingosine (plasma lyso-Gb<3>).
12. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein the migalastat or salt thereof reduces cardiac hypertrophy of the left ventricle.
13. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the migalastat or salt thereof improves renal function.
14. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to any one of claims 1 to 13, wherein the patient is male.
15. Migalastat or a salt thereof for use according to any one of claims 1 to 13, wherein the patient is female.
